snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide Skitarii class gameplay trailer - PC Gaming Show 2026
snippet.description:
Fight for the glory of the Machine God. The next class coming to Warhammer 40,000: Darktide is none other than the Skitarii, members of the Adeptus Machanicus. The Skitarii class will be available on June 23.

Wishlist the Skitarii upgrade on Steam:
 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4355580/Warhammer_40000_Darktide__Skitarii_Class_Deluxe_Edition/
